_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Single Player vs Dealer

📖 GAME OVERVIEW:
• Mangrugi ka ti {start_chips} chips
• Single deck ti 52 karta (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Agay-ayam ka ti dealer (house)
• Tunggal round ket agsusurot iti Ultimate Texas Hold'em structure: ipost mo ti ANTE ken BLIND bets, awaten ti 2 hole cards, desidiren no optional PLAY bets iti betting phases, kalpasanna reveal community cards ken ikompara ti best 5-card hand mo ti dealer’s. Ti gannuat mo ket agmaximize ti winnings mo (no adda ka ti nasayaat a hand), bayat a agminimize ti losses mo (no adda ka ti napasamak a hand).
• Agpatingga ti game no maabot mo ti 0 chips wenno baba iti start ti round (LOSS) wenno ikompleto mo ti 1000 rounds ti chips (WIN)

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Mandatory ${ante} bet tunggal round
• BLIND: Mandatory ${ante} bet tunggal round
• PLAY: Optional bet iti gameplay. Iti tunggal round, mabalin mo a pagpilian ti ONLY ONE ti sumaganad: (${ante4} no aramiden iti PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} no aramiden iti FLOP, wenno ${ante} no aramiden iti RIVER. Mabalin met a fold iti river, agsuko iti hand, ken awan bet.)

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• Awaten mo ti 2 face-up cards (dagiti hole cards mo)
• Dealer ket awaten ti 2 face-down cards (nakatagoan iti sika)
• 5 community cards ket naidealtan face-down initially
• Community cards ket naireveal progressively iti game phases

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer ket nasken a adda ti PAIR (2 karta ti isu met laeng a ranggo) a qualify, usaren dagiti 2 karta iti hand da ken dagiti 5 community cards.
• Dealer qualification ket apektaran ti betting outcomes, kas iti maipatarus dita.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] (${ante4}) wenno [check]
  • [4x]: Ipost ${ante4} PLAY bet, reveals first 3 community cards
  • [check]: Awan additional bet, reveals first 3 community cards

📋 FLOP:
  • No 4x bet: Only [skip] available (auto-reveals last 2 community cards)
  • No 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) wenno [check]
  • [2x]: Ipost ${ante2} PLAY bet, reveals last 2 community cards
  • [check]: Awan additional bet, reveals last 2 community cards

📋 RIVER:
  • No 4x wenno 2x bet: Only [skip] available (auto-proceeds iti showdown)
  • No prior PLAY bet: [1x] (${ante}) wenno [fold]
  • [1x]: Ipost ${ante} PLAY bet, proceeds iti showdown
  • [fold]: Agsuko iti hand, lose ANTE ken BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Amin a karta ket naireveal ken naievaluate
  • Best 5-card hand iti 7 karta (2 hole + 5 community)
  • Bets settled according iti payout rules

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer doesn't qualify: PUSH (bet returned)
  • Dealer qualifies & you win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Dealer qualifies & you lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Unaffected by dealer qualification
  • You win: Bet returned ken additional payout based iti hand strength mo
  • You lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Awan additional payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Unaffected by dealer qualification
  • Direct comparison: Best hand mo vs Dealer's best hand
  • You win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • You lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best to Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 ti isu met laeng a suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 consecutive karta ti isu met laeng a suit
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 karta ti isu met laeng a ranggo
  4. Full House: 3 ti isu met laeng a ranggo + 2 ti isu met laeng a ranggo
  5. Flush: 5 karta ti isu met laeng a suit
  6. Straight: 5 consecutive karta
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 karta ti isu met laeng a ranggo
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs ti sabali a ranggo
  9. One Pair: 2 karta ti isu met laeng a ranggo
  10. High Card: Highest karta wins

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] wenno [play bet 4x]: Ipost ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] wenno [play bet 2x]: Ipost ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] wenno [play bet 1x]: Ipost ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] wenno [c]: Check (awan additional bet)
• [fold] wenno [f]: Fold (agsuko iti hand)
• [skip] wenno [s]: Skip iti next phase (no action needed)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Strong starting hands (pairs, high karta) often justify 4x bets
• Consider dealer qualification - weak hands may push no dealer doesn't qualify
• BLIND bet can be very profitable with strong hands (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Watch your chip stack! No maabot iti 0 wenno baba iti start ti round, you lose.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE ken BLIND bets are mandatory tunggal round
• PLAY bets are optional ken strategic
• Make sure you input the correct action, ken only one action iti time.
